key.name: window-width
key.description: Width of the main application window in pixels.

key.name: window-height
key.description: Height of the main application window in pixels.

key.name: last-folder
key.description: Restored when the app opens. Empty or "unified" is Unified Inbox. "view" followed by unit separator U+001F and a UUID restores an extension view (the form earlier builds wrote is read the same way). Otherwise account UUID, unit separator U+001F, then the IMAP mailbox name.

key.name: last-account
key.description: Account UUID shown in the account switcher. Restored when the app opens so views that span accounts (such as Unified Inbox) keep the account you last picked. Empty means the first account.

key.name: load-remote-images
key.description: When true, remote images in HTML mail are loaded automatically. Defaults to false for privacy.

key.name: show-verification-codes
key.description: When a message contains a one-time sign-in or verification code, show it in the reader with a copy button. Detection stays on this device.

key.name: cleanup-verification-codes
key.summary: Move verification messages to Trash after copy
key.description: After the user copies a verification code from the reader, move that message to Trash. Has no effect when Show verification codes is off, when the message is already in Trash, or when the account has no Trash folder. Undo is offered from the toast.

key.name: show-message-preview
key.summary: Show message previews in the list
key.description: When true, each message row shows a snippet preview below the subject.

key.name: list-density
key.description: Spacing in the message list and reading pane: compact, comfortable, or relaxed.

key.name: message-list-mode
key.description: Group replies into conversations, or show one row per message.

key.name: color-scheme
key.description: Follow the system color scheme, or force light or dark.

key.name: accent-color
key.description: Accent color used for buttons, links, and highlights. "default" follows the system accent color.

key.name: application-font-size
key.description: GTK interface text size in pixels (10–24). Default 14.

key.name: reader-font-size
key.description: Mail body text size in the reading pane, in pixels (10–24). Default 14.

key.name: editor-font-size
key.description: Compose body text size in pixels (10–24). Default 14.

key.name: close-to-tray
key.description: When true, closing the window hides it in the notification area instead of quitting.

key.name: reading-pane
key.description: When set to right, the reading pane appears beside the message list. When set to bottom, it appears below the list.

key.name: compose-format
key.description: Default body format for new messages and replies: plain, html, or markdown.

key.name: spell-check-inline
key.description: Underline misspelled words in the compose body as you type.

key.name: spell-check-autocomplete
key.description: Show a suggestion popover when the caret rests on a misspelled word in plain text or Markdown.

key.name: spell-check-autocorrect
key.description: Replace a misspelled word with the top dictionary suggestion when a word boundary is typed. Plain text and Markdown only.

key.name: spell-check-before-send
key.description: Review misspelled words in a dialog before the message is sent.

key.name: spell-check-language
key.description: Enchant language code (for example en_US). Empty follows the system language.

key.name: send-delay-seconds
key.description: Seconds to hold an outgoing message so it can be taken back. 0 sends immediately.

key.name: request-mdn
key.description: When true, outgoing mail requests a read receipt (MDN).

key.name: collect-outgoing-contacts
key.description: When true, addresses you send to are saved as unapproved contacts until you keep them.

key.name: insert-tracking-pixel
key.description: Off by default. When true, a hidden remote image from tracking-pixel-url is inserted into outgoing HTML mail so opens can be detected; the composer shows a disclosure banner while it is on.

key.name: tracking-pixel-url
key.description: HTTPS URL for the outbound tracking pixel image.

key.name: collapsed-folders
key.description: Per-account collapsed sidebar folders. Each entry is account-uuid, unit separator U+001F, then the IMAP mailbox name.

key.name: compose-format-by-account
key.description: Each entry is account-uuid, unit separator U+001F, then plain, html, or markdown. Accounts not listed use the global default compose format preference.

key.name: folder-pane-accounts
key.description: picker shows one account at a time behind the account picker. stacked shows every account as a collapsible section with its folders when there are two or more accounts.

key.name: collapsed-accounts
key.description: Account UUIDs whose section is collapsed in the stacked folder pane.

key.name: collapsed-personal-folders
key.description: Account UUIDs whose Folders group (the user-created IMAP folders) is collapsed to a single row in the folder pane. Default expanded.

key.name: hidden-accounts
key.description: Account UUIDs moved into the Hidden Accounts area at the bottom of the stacked folder pane.

key.name: account-order
key.description: Account UUIDs in the order shown in the stacked folder pane and the account picker. Accounts not listed follow in their existing order.

key.name: keyboard-shortcut-overrides
key.description: Custom accelerators. Each entry is a GIO action name, unit separator U+001F, then a GTK shortcut trigger (for example app.command-palette then Ctrl+K). Empty means all defaults.

key.name: recent-move-folders
key.description: Most-recent-first FolderId integers as decimal strings. Max 5.

key.name: message-list-column-widths
key.description: Pixel widths for resizable message-list columns. Each entry is column-id, colon, then a positive integer (from, folder, subject, size, date). A per-mailbox row is view-key, U+001F, then id:width pairs separated by commas. Mailboxes without a row use the unscoped widths.

key.name: folder-pane-width
key.description: Width in pixels of the folders column in the main window. Clamped to 180–560.

key.name: folders-docked
key.description: When true, the folders column stays beside the message list. When false, folders are hidden and slide out over the list while the pointer rests on the left edge of the window.

key.name: rail-expanded
key.description: When true, the far-left app rail shows icon and label. When false, it shows icons only.

key.name: rail-width
key.description: Width in pixels of the far-left app rail (56–280). Zero means derive from rail-expanded.

key.name: rail-visible
key.description: When false, the far-left app rail is hidden.

key.name: message-list-column-order
key.description: User-facing column ids left to right (unread, from, folder, subject, attachments, star, size, date). Unknown ids are ignored. A per-mailbox row is view-key, U+001F, then column ids separated by commas. Mailboxes without a row use the unscoped order.

key.name: message-list-column-visible
key.description: Column ids that are shown (unread, from, folder, subject, attachments, star, size, date). Omitted ids are hidden. A per-mailbox row is view-key, U+001F, then column ids separated by commas. Mailboxes without a row use the unscoped list.

key.name: message-list-sort-column
key.description: from, subject, date, or size. Trash Deleted sort is not stored.

key.name: message-list-sort-order
key.description: ascending or descending.

key.name: activity-log-limit
key.description: Maximum in-memory activity log entries. Oldest rows are dropped when full.

key.name: activity-log-filter
key.description: Bit mask of visible activity kinds: mail 1, sync 2, accounts 4, contacts 16, failures 32 (8 is unused). Default 63 is all. Zero hides every row.

key.name: risky-attachment-extensions
key.description: File extensions that need confirmation before an attachment is opened or saved.

key.name: risky-attachment-mime-types
key.description: MIME types that need confirmation before an attachment is opened or saved.

key.name: typical-inline-image-extensions
key.description: Image types most email clients can display inline. Other image types can still be inserted; Alcedo warns that some clients may not show them.
